items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: He said, you see the band we had at the Moulin Rouge? ... He said, we all been on the top. You know, we had a real Dixieland band

ctx.x: Those were the first ones, with the Emil Barnes, the Harrison Barnes.

No, the first ones. You know, first ones. I'll tell you one thing Mr. Bill. With the band we had at the Moulin Rouge during the time of the war, boy play bass now, right now with Fat Pichon. He tell anybody. He say he made more money with us than any band he ever played with. And he said, and he, the last time I saw that boy, he told me, I was on the Boulin Rouge, he said, Kitsy, you know what I'm saying? He said, you see the band we had at the Moulin Rouge? He said, boy we all been on the top. You know, we had a…
Yeah, sometimes. You don't get the breaks.
